description: A dispositive control is attributed even though it did not narrow the verdict.
note: THIS VECTOR CAUGHT A BUG IN THE SPECIFICATION, not in an implementation. VERD-4 originally required the last control that NARROWED, which attributes this to policy -- so the record would say an agent was stopped by a rule when the truth is it tried to pay a sanctioned party. An operator raising the limit would find the payment still refused and no explanation on the record.
